projects.title: SEOkun
projects.description: A code-aware SEO audit engine that runs Lighthouse over Playwright and traces every finding back to the exact file and line, so AI agents like Claude can fix issues directly in code — built around GitHub OAuth, an MCP server, and a decoupled audit engine.
